nav.title: MicStream
nav.description: Opens a microphone and hands out its live MediaStream, raw samples and a level — everything else in audio/ subscribes to one of these.

nav.title: Recite
nav.description: Reads the AI's replies aloud with a local voice: pause, back 10 s, restart, and it pauses when you talk.

nav.title: Recorder
nav.description: Record, play back and save (download) one clip — MediaRecorder underneath.

nav.title: Transcriber
nav.description: An audio stream in, a text stream out — swappable engines: local Whisper, or Chrome's own recognizer.

nav.title: audio v1
nav.description: The six-class version of audio/, kept clickable for comparison — MicPicker, LevelMeter and PushToTalk are now absorbed into MicStream on the main page.

nav.title: Voice
nav.description: Text to speech — the browser's own SpeechSynthesis reads text out loud.

nav.title: Whisper
nav.description: Every answer the speech server sends back, live: guesses that amend themselves, then the final.
